args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully (status: rolled_out). Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy).
2. **Identified target**: From deployment history, v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1 (seq 3) was the unhealthy deploy.
3. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions — rollback completed successfully.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback (on-call paged).
5. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release but was unhealthy in production; it should be investigated before any future deploy.
